subject: science
skillName: Designing a Device That Changes Energy Forms

items.prompt:
A hand-crank flashlight changes motion energy into electrical energy and then into
A) sound
B) light
C) water
D) wind

steps: The electrical energy becomes light at the bulb.

items.prompt:
A rubber-band car moves because stored energy changes into
A) motion
B) color
C) sound only
D) nothing

steps: The stretched band's stored energy becomes motion.

items.prompt:
A solar cell changes light energy into
A) sound
B) electrical energy
C) wind
D) weight

steps: Solar cells convert light into electricity.

items.prompt:
The three steps engineers use to make a device are
A) design, test, refine
B) buy, sell, trade
C) draw, color, cut
D) run, jump, stop

A solar toy stops in the shade because
A) it is tired
B) it has no light to convert into electrical energy
C) it is too heavy
D) the shade is cold
items.answer: B) it has no light to convert into electrical energy

steps: Without light the solar cell cannot power it.

items.prompt:
To refine a rubber-band car that rolls a short distance, you could
A) wind the band more
B) remove the wheels
C) make it heavier for no reason
D) do nothing

steps: Storing more energy lets the car go farther.

items.prompt:
The full chain of energy changes in a hand-crank flashlight is
A) light to sound to motion
B) motion to electrical to light
C) heat to light to sound
D) sound to motion to light
items.answer: B) motion to electrical to light

steps: The crank's motion becomes electricity, then light.

items.prompt:
Why is testing important when building an energy-converting device?
A) It wastes time
B) It shows how well the device works and what to improve
C) It makes the device heavier
D) It is not important
items.answer: B) It shows how well the device works and what to improve
